description:
Minecraft has never been more multiplayer-friendly! Laura is here to introduce the new Parties feature, which allows you to group up with friends and seamlessly switch between worlds, realms, and multiplayer adventures. Plus, discover new multiplayer adventures, including GenWars, a persistent PvP server, Treasure Hunt, a fast-paced competitive mining adventure, SoulSteel, a multiplayer dungeoneering adventure, Mob Maze, a gigantic Minecraft labyrinth packed with huge mobs, traps, and puzzles, and more!

description:
Welcome to the Minecraft Live Community Pre-show, where we celebrate Minecrafters and their mind-blowing creativity! Join Hannahxxrose and Pac as they introduce us to some incredibly talented creators, with their breathtaking builds and novel ideas.

Discover ElRichMC, Dramatic Herbalist, TAMAchan, Luna_Cupcake, and EdgeCase’s Minecraft passion projects. Hear about KurtJMac’s years-long journey to the Farlands, get a glimpse into Wifies’s passion for mystery solving, and watch Tubbo’s Mid-offs, a celebration of mediocre Minecraft speedrunning.
